meta.name: game-design-fundamentals
meta.description: The foundational design discipline — the spine the rest of the pack cross-links to. Use when judging whether a mechanic is fun, auditing a system for balance, designing difficulty/flow, setting reward schedules, checking player motivation, or diagnosing "my choices don't matter" / "this is grindy" / "this difficulty spike feels cheap". Covers interesting decisions (Sid Meier), flow & difficulty curves, intrinsic/extrinsic motivation (Self-Determination Theory), feedback & agency, and choice architecture. Triggers on "is this fun", "interesting decision", "dominant strategy", "balance this", "difficulty curve", "flow", "reward schedule", "player motivation", "fake choice", "analysis paralysis", "one more turn".
